name: Hotel Receptionist
text: Welcome. We're the Sleepywood Hotel. Our hotel works hard to serve you the best at all times. If you are tired and worn out from hunting, how about a relaxing stay at our hotel?

name: Hotel Receptionist
text: We offer two kinds of rooms for service. Please choose the one of your liking.

name: Hotel Receptionist
text: You've chosen the regular sauna. Your HP and MP will recover fast and you can even purchase some items there. Are you sure you want to go in?

name: Hotel Receptionist
text: You've chosen the VIP sauna. Your HP and MP will recover even faster than that of the regular sauna and you can even find a special item in there. Are you sure you want to go in?

name: Hotel Receptionist
text: [STATE-DEPENDENT: checks player.hasMesos(499). If true, deducts 499 mesos and teleports the player to Map 105040401 (Regular Sauna). If false, shows: "I'm sorry. It looks like you don't have enough mesos. It will cost you 499 mesos to stay at our hotel."]

name: Hotel Receptionist
text: We offer other kinds of services, too, so please think carefully and then make your decision.
